notes: Request ID sequence counters discard stale chunk responses on rapid switch.

notes: Project dropdown loads records and emits projectswitch event.

notes: SLDS tabs render active view (graph, matrix, findings). Other 15 views not registered.

name: Selection != Navigation Invariant
notes: Selecting node updates inspection panel without changing view route or project.

name: User-Scoped Preference Isolation
notes: SOQL queries filter by User__c = :UserInfo.getUserId() and Project__c.

name: Strict Project-Scoped Preset Isolation
notes: Presets validated and scoped to active project; cross-project presets filtered out.

name: Architectural Node Annotations
notes: CRUD operations for node annotations persist into DA_Annotation__c object.

name: Global Search & Command Palette
notes: Keyboard shortcut command palette and global search modal not migrated.

name: Deep URL Routing & State Deserialization
notes: LWC uses Lightning Navigation and component state rather than direct URL query string syncing.

name: Data Export (PNG, CSV, JSON)
notes: Canvas export and data download handlers not implemented in LWC.

name: TypeScript AST Parsing & Extraction
notes: CLI parses AST and extracts imports externally due to Apex governor limits.

name: Bounded Chunk Retrieval & Payload Assembly

name: Graph Cycles & Hub Analytics
